title: Walk your dog to 5 Points; 3 mins drive downtown!
description:
Close to airport, In the heartbeat of Nashville! A TWO MINUTE WALK to 5 Points with dining, shopping; a dog hospital two blocks. away; walk twelve blocks to downtown, otherwise  a 3-4 MINUTE DRIVE TO DOWNTOWN: Titans, Predators,  Ascend Amphitheater, Bridgestone Arena, Honkey Tonks, restaurants, EVRYTHING exciting downtown!. This completely renovated studio guesthouse has its own PRIVATE PARKING with SECURITY GATE, small YARD for your dogs.  STR Permit # 20/18/0732/68.

The space
Whether looking for a "touch of home" while away, or simply a fun get-away, this studio guesthouse in the historic district is perfect! 
The yard is small, but fully fenced, important when your dogs need to get some exercise - this is a dog loving neighborhood. Dog waste pickup by Poop 911 every Monday and Thursday.
If you love to cook, there are fresh herbs, peppers, and tomatoes (during season).
Entrance is from the alley, and has a security gate for secured parking. There is a completely private entryway into the guesthouse.
Once inside, you have room to live, not just sleep and bathe. The entire guesthouse was gutted to the studs and rebuilt, so although this is a historic neighborhood, you don't have to deal with old "iffy" plumbing, electrical, etc. 
Everything in the kitchen is available for your consumption.
The bed is queen sized, but there is additional sleeping space for a third /fourth person on the queen sleeper sofa.
In the basket by the couch where you will also find a couple of large pet towels/blankets for your pets that you can throw on the couch or bed to protect it from excess shedding and/or dirt, for those of you that love to snuggle or sleep with your pets - this is their vacation, too!

Guest access
It is fully fenced with an electronic gate, and private secured parking/patio space for your use.. You have your own small yard, too, which is privacy fenced. Everything is privately accessed through the alleyway entrance.

Other things to note
There are dog sheets and blankets in the wicker basket to throw over the furniture and bed for the dogs. We love having your furry family members stay with us, but it will help housekeeping if we can assist in reducing the dog hair!
Thank you in advance!
